approaches.name: digital stock assessment tools and AI catch monitoring
approaches.description: The project deploys data management systems, electronic tags, low-cost radars and AI to collect, analyze and enforce fisheries catch data. Practices: data- and capacity-limited stock assessment tools and fisheries data management systems; electronic tags, low-cost radars and AI for catch reporting and enforcement.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: data-limited stock assessment methods and data-poor fisheries information systems for management advice | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, rare_or_absent before 2019

evidence.text: (b) improving the stock assessments through the implementation and expansion of tools and capacity for the application of data- and capacity-limited approaches to the production of stock assessment and fisheries management advice, at national and regional level;

extra_evidence.text: (c) supporting the adoption of sustainable systems and processes for managing and accessing information and statistics on data-poor and capacity-limited fisheries, covering most steps of the fisheries data process, from collection to analysis, as well as data management, and recovering and making available relevant data from previous projects in the SWIO region;

This subcomponent will include: (a) applying enhanced catch reporting, innovations such as electronic tags, low-cost radars and artificial intelligence, and undertaking scientific studies to support implementation, periodic evaluation and updating of climate-resilient fisheries management plans already prepared such as the grouper management plan, the diamond squid management plan, and the bait fish management plan;

approaches.name: regional fisheries dashboard for data analysis and sharing
approaches.description: The project builds an operational SWIOFC regional dashboard to analyze and share fisheries data, stock findings and management plan evaluations across SWIO countries. Practices: regional fisheries dashboard for sharing management plan evaluations; regional fisheries dashboard for data analysis and sharing; Regional fisheries database dashboard for stock and M&E data sharing.
